angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) vs NFL pass-rush pressure; no-tracking baseline (log pick, weight, NGS athleticism, EDGE share); Bayesian exposure-weighted headline, fully nested out-of-class test, 2023-25 board
metric_name: Hoop G: the hardest sideways push a rusher holds for 0.5 s while rounding the hoops (g, z within Combine year), corrected for one-run reliability 0.41
headline_number: Bayesian beta-binomial model (90 hoop runners with an NFL rush, class random intercept, EDGE/interior slopes, measurement-error-corrected bend, prior scaled to the typical screened effect): 0.9 extra pressures per 450-rush season per sd of measured bend, 90% interval [-0.1, 1.9], P(>0.5) = 0.74; pick 100 -> 75. Primary out-of-class estimate (fully nested LOCO, screening + reliability + shrinkage refit in each fold): held-out R2 change -0.028 [-0.314, 0.210], hoop chosen in 2 of 3 folds.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_04/cand_1. (1) Headline replaced by one Bayesian partial-pooling posterior (beta-binomial, rushes as exposure, all 90 runners with an NFL rush instead of the 100-rush cut, games/season covariate, class random intercept, EDGE/interior slopes, latent true bend with reliability 0.41 by Gauss-Hermite), with P(effect>0.5) and a wide-prior sensitivity; raw/shrunk/true-score variants moved to the table/appendix. (2) Fully nested leave-one-class-out with selection among 14 pairs, in-fold reliability and in-fold EB shrinkage (plus an in-fold imputation variant), per-class and pooled dR2 with 1000 class-stratified player bootstraps; presented as the single out-of-class estimate; 'real in-sample link' wording dropped. (3) New placebo outcome (run-stop proxy: TFL per run snap) and negative-control drill (back-pedal speed). (4) Path-based win-type check on 925 EDGE-aligned sampled rushes (outside arc / inside cross / through): bend does not predict outside-arc share (rho 0.04); stated plainly that Hoop G is not shown to be corner-bend technique; 'general change-of-direction trait' claim removed; blocker/alignment added as a flagged limitation. (5) Fig 1 rebuilt as four named rushers (Chop Robinson, Ezeiruaku, Phillips, McGuire) with hoop run, NFL paths coloured by win type, pressures marked in a colour distinct from the black Hoop G ring, yard axes, larger headers; old Fig 5 film cards and the redundant dumbbell panel dropped. (6) Board published inline: 2025 top 8 + bottom 4 and every 2023-24 non-neutral call, with pick, weight, role, shrunk bend [80%], pressure vs forecast, call; Fig 5 cut to the 9 informative 2025 rows with fixed axis labels and a film-first legend entry. (7) Fig 2 direct 'after baseline' labels and n values in caption; Fig 3 faceted by 40 status, labels only for Fig 1 players; Fig 4 now posterior + nested-test violins with clipped share printed. (8) Opening rewritten to 55 plain words; Finding 2 = table + ~100 words; 36% bootstrap share, mixed model, best-of-14 moved to appendix or cut; subgroup restated as a null check; 'no-40 group matters most' removed. (9) numbers.json now holds only the values quoted in the text (one key per claim, plus sign-free copies for check.py). 5 figures + 4 tables, 1,957 words.
open_risks: The out-of-class test is null (pooled dR2 -0.028) and the hoop is re-selected in only 2 of 3 folds; judges may read the whole piece as a null with a soft headline.
The headline posterior depends on the prior: a wide prior gives 2.5 pressures [0.9, 4.3]; the headline prior scale is derived from the same 14 screened effects.
The win-type classifier is a path proxy (lateral position at 3 yd depth, outside = away from field centre) with no ball, blockers or film; it is a null and cannot anchor bend to technique.
Pre-registered 2026-27 test has power 0.13 at the headline effect.
Full script takes about 18 minutes (1000 nested-loop bootstraps and two 4-chain MCMC fits).
